svg.text: ESP32-C6 ADS-B radar — breadboard wiring (Seeed XIAO ESP32C6)
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32C6 · 1.28" GC9A01 round display (TinyTronics) · 10× WS2812 strip · matches main.py with BOARD = "XIAO_C6"
top rail: + = 5 V · – = GND (bottom rails unused)
WS2812 strip · 10 LEDs · connect to the DIN (input) end
Strip GND → GND via top – rail
Strip DIN → D0 · GPIO 0 through 330 Ω
Board shown from the top, USB-C to the left. The XIAO ships WITHOUT headers:
solder them first. Seeed's SCK/MOSI labels don't matter — SPI goes to any pin.
Display is 3.3 V: never connect its VCC to 5 V. Strip is 5 V, powered from USB 5V.
Keep LED_BRIGHT low; optional 470–1000 µF capacitor across strip 5V/GND.
All grounds are common (board GND → top – rail). Keep display wires short (≤10 cm).
5V pin is USB power only (dead on battery). main.py sets GPIO3/14 low = onboard antenna.
